n = int(input())
s = input()

import re

regex = r"\([a-zA-Z_]*\)"
new_string = re.sub(regex, "_", s)

left = re.split(r"_+", new_string)
max_length = max((len(part) for part in left), default=0)

print(max_length)

count = 0
is_start = False
start_index = -1
end_index = -1

for i, c in enumerate(s):
    if c == '(':
        is_start = True
        start_index = i
        continue
    if is_start:
        if c == ')':
            is_start = False
            end_index = i
            tmp = s[start_index+1:end_index]
            if tmp == "":
                continue
            if tmp.startswith('_'):
                tmps = re.split(r"_+", tmp)
                if len(tmps) != 0:
                    count += len(tmps) - 1
                else:
                    count += len(tmps)
            else:
                tmps = re.split(r"_+", tmp)
                count += len(tmps)

print(count)
